summary: I've been a developer since 1998 and a full stack web developer since 2004, I have 19 years of experience, as a Functional Analyst but also as a developer with PHP (19+ yrs), Javascript (19+ yrs), NodeJS (4+ yrs), VueJS (5+ yrs), ReactJS (2+ yrs), I have a colege degree in System Analysis.
I have worked in many industries and many different companies with its peculiarities, I'm an active listener so I can offer the best solution for your particular needs and objectives.

I truly love development. I get excited every time my favorite languages and tools release a new feature. I love to learn new things, so sometimes go on and on talking about development all day with my dev friends.

In 2012 I co-founded a startup called aluGuest (it was operative until 2017), a platform for temporary accommodation rental. I build the architecture for aluGuest from zero, I was able to gather a small but solid web development and design team to solve our needs, at the time there was no React, no Vue or even Node yet, or they were in very early stages (beta versions or prior), so I build a solid platform using jQuery, PHP, MySQL and MongoDB, it was fast and bullet proof, we process credit cards and handle money, we didn't have any security breach and the code was robust.

Later in 2017 I learned VueJS, I was part of several projects using it, a very large one for the Argentina government (a Transportation Agency), and other private held companies in the most diverse applications, also rebuild my ex partner's (from aluGuest) company ecommerce platform (a small temp apartment rental agency in Buenos Aires) Welcome2BA, using NuxtJS (a VueJS framework) and PHP 7.
In the latest years I worked with ReactJS, NextJS and some minor VueJS projects. I also worked in backend creating APIs and batch applications in NodeJS and PHP.
I have more to share, so I hope we can meet soon.
